result.uploadedKept: Uploaded. The other machine's previous backup was kept as a fallback.
result.restoredLocal: Restored from {{device}}'s backup. What was on this machine was kept in a local copy.

sync.replaceConfirm: {{device}}'s backup will be replaced with this machine's data. It's kept as the “previous backup” in {{provider}}.
sync.restoreSetupConfirm: This machine's connections, folders, queries and preferences will be replaced by the backup's. What's here now is kept in an encrypted local copy, in case you need it.
sync.restoreNowConfirm: This machine's data will be replaced by the backup in {{provider}}. The current data is kept in an encrypted local copy.
sync.passChanged: Passphrase changed. Your other machines will ask for it the next time they sync.
sync.disconnectConfirm: DBine stops syncing on this machine and forgets the account and the passphrase. Your local connections and queries are not touched.
sync.deleteRemoteConfirm: Also delete the backup stored in {{provider}}? If you have other machines syncing, they'll upload it again.
sync.restoreLocalConfirm: Goes back to the state of {{date}}. The current state is kept in another local copy, and the change is uploaded on the next sync.
sync.dirty: There are changes not uploaded yet.
sync.dirtyAuto: There are changes not uploaded yet: they'll be uploaded in a few seconds.

hint.googleDrive: In a private DBine folder in your Drive.
hint.onedrive: In Apps › DBine, in your OneDrive.

sync.heading: Cloud sync
sync.intro: A copy of your connections, queries and preferences to recover them on another machine.
sync.secureLine: Stored encrypted in your account. It can't be recovered without the passphrase.
sync.secureTitle: The file is stored encrypted in your own account
sync.secureBody: It's encrypted with a passphrase you choose after connecting the account.
sync.secureWarning: If you lose the passphrase, there's no way to recover the data.
sync.signInBrowser: Finish signing in in the browser…
sync.foundBackupBody: {device} saved it on {{date}}. Type the passphrase you chose on that machine to bring everything here.
sync.replaceWithThis: No, replace it with this machine's data
sync.replaceHeading: Replace the backup with this machine's data
sync.passphraseHelp: This passphrase encrypts the file and every new machine asks for it. Keep it safe: without it nothing can be recovered.
sync.understood: I understand that if I lose the passphrase, the backup can't be recovered.
sync.wrongPassphrase: The passphrase saved on this machine doesn't open the backup. You probably changed it on another machine: type the new one.
sync.signInAgain: {{provider}} asks you to sign in again (access was revoked or expired).
sync.autoHelp: Uploads changes as you make them and brings in those from your other machines.
sync.localCopiesHelp: What was on this machine before each restore (encrypted, the last 10).
